summary: An area's port list is kept by naval base level, largest first, so "the first port" is the largest; and max_ic is the unscaled base. Both found by setting the rewrite's replay against the savegame's 261 convoys.

addresses.name: PortList_InsertByLevel
addresses.comment: **Keeps an area's port list by size, largest first.** Walks the list from its tail and puts the new province behind the first one whose CMapProvince::UsableNavalBaseLevel is not smaller than its own; where every one is smaller it goes to the front. So of two ports alike the one handed in first stays ahead, and `ports_first`'s first element is the area's largest harbour - which is what every reader of "the area's first port" gets. Called by COwnerArea::RefreshBases for each port of the area in the area's province order. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-supplyconvoys.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C and the listing 0x481AA0..0x481AF8: `cmp [eax], ecx; jge` at 0x481ADB leaves the walk at the first node whose level is at least the new one's; the fall-through at 0x481AE6 is the push to the front (0x45F5E0). `ret 8`.

addresses.name: AirBaseList_InsertByLevel
addresses.comment: Keeps an area's air base list by size, largest first, the way PortList_InsertByLevel keeps its ports: from the tail, behind the first whose air base's maximum level in whole levels is not smaller, else at the front. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-supplyconvoys.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Read from the decompiled C, 0x481B90 on; `ret 8`.

addresses.name: CMapProvince::UsableNavalBaseLevel
addresses.comment: The naval base's **current** level, in thousandths - or 0 for an owned port with a base whose sea province is in one particular sea region (the first entry of the sea province's +0x358 list equal to the global at 0x1A8558C) while WaterIsClosed says the water at the third pair of the defines' `map` block is shut to the province's owner. Which region that is was not established. What PortList_InsertByLevel orders an area's ports by. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-supplyconvoys.md, section 4.
addresses.evidence: Read from the listing, 0x4A7EE0 to the `ret` at 0x4A7F77: the level is written to the out at 0x4A7EF3 before any test, and zeroed only at 0x4A7F6C.

struct_fields.name: ports_first
struct_fields.comment: Head of the list of the area's provinces that have a naval base; count at +0x50. **Kept by size, largest first** (PortList_InsertByLevel), and of two alike in the area's province order - so its first element is the area's largest harbour, which is what the convoy routines mean by an area's first port. CAIInvasion stage 1 walks it at 0x8A0377 to find the nearest reachable port for a land unit, and CEU3AI::PlanAmphibiousInvasion walks it at 0x892C87 to pick the invasion's objective port, reading NavalBaseCapacity off a member at 0x8930AD. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-supplyconvoys.md, section 4.
struct_fields.evidence: COwnerArea::RefreshBases fills it through PortList_InsertByLevel and nothing else was found appending to it.
struct_fields.revises: The comment did not say the list is ordered; it is, by naval base level.

struct_fields.name: air_bases_first
struct_fields.comment: The area's provinces with an air base of level 1 or more; count at +0x60. Filled by COwnerArea::RefreshBases beside the port list, and **kept by size, largest first** (AirBaseList_InsertByLevel). See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-supplynetwork.md, section 2, and reversing/findings/FINDINGS-supplyconvoys.md, section 4.
struct_fields.revises: The comment did not say the list is ordered.

struct_fields.name: max_ic
struct_fields.comment: **GetMaxIC: the IC of the country's provinces summed, in whole IC, with no country scaling on it.** CCountry::UpdateIC writes the summed province base to this and to the total at +0x604 from one register at 0xF0FA3 and never touches this one again; only +0x604 is then scaled by the country's modifiers and technology, capped at what resources support and topped up with the resource-free IC at +0x608. RunSupplyAndConvoyIterations gives a country with no transports half of this, and the start-date savegame has exactly half the unscaled figure free for 19 of 19 countries. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-supplyconvoys.md, section 6.
struct_fields.evidence: The read at 0x67906F in RunSupplyAndConvoyIterations, and the savegame: Germany 72 free of a base of 144 where the scaled figure is 201.
struct_fields.revises: The comment said it was the province base 'with the country scaling'; the comment on +0x604 beside it already said this one is the base, and the save agrees with that.

notes: Nothing here was watched in a running game.
